ItemID: 1; Title: Fintie Rotating Case for iPad 9th Generation (2021) / 8th Generation (2020) / 7th Gen (2019) 10.2 Inch - 360 Degree Rotating Stand Cover with Pencil Holder, Auto Wake Sleep, Starry Night; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My tablet history is with a Fire 7; this case would not fit it.
ItemID: 2; Title: USB C Adapters for MacBook Pro/Air, 9 in 1 USB C Hub with 4K HDMI, USB 3.1 10Gbps Data Ports, 2*USB-C 3.1 GEN2, 1Gbps Ethernet, 2*USB 3.0 and SD/TF Slots, for MacBook Air/Pro, XPS, and More; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The memory-card slots interest me, but I already have a card reader and no established need for a USB-C hub.
ItemID: 3; Title: Fire TV Gaming Bundle with Fire TV Stick 4K Max and Luna Controller; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: TV accessories interest me, but I have no current need for a gaming controller or gaming bundle.
ItemID: 4; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this to add streaming to my television; the streaming function matters more to me than the 4K features.
ItemID: 5; Title: TOZO NC2 Hybrid Active Noise Cancelling Wireless Earbuds, in-Ear Detection Headphones, IPX6 Waterproof Bluetooth 5.2 Stereo Earphones, Immersive Sound Premium Deep Bass Headset, Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in practical camera, storage, and connection accessories right now than new earbuds.
ItemID: 6; Title: Echo Dot (2nd Generation) - Smart speaker with Alexa - White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A voice-controlled speaker does not address a current need in my device setup.
ItemID: 7; Title: Plantronics - Voyager 5200 UC (Poly) - Bluetooth Single-Ear (Monaural) Headset - USB-A Compatible to connect to your PC and/or Mac - Works with Teams, Zoom & more - Noise Canceling; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not currently need a dedicated headset for calls or meetings.
ItemID: 8; Title: Blink Whole Home Bundle | Video Doorbell System, Outdoor camera, and Mini camera | HD video, motion detection, Works with Alexa; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My camera purchases relate to photography accessories, and I am not currently looking for a home security system.
ItemID: 9; Title: 1byone Amplified HD Digital TV Antenna - Support 4K 1080p and All Older TV's - Indoor Smart Switch Amplifier Signal Booster - Coax HDTV Cable/AC Adapter; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this for local channels on my television, although its usefulness would depend on reception at home.
ItemID: 10; Title: Echo Buds (1st Gen) – Wireless earbuds with immersive sound, active noise reduction, and Alexa; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no immediate need for wireless earbuds, and Alexa integration is not a reason for me to buy them.
